name: TC-SL-005 — 新增视觉迭代弹窗与校验 [P0]
description: 验证新增视觉迭代：前置条件检查、迭代名称必填且最多40字、创建后进入Brief草稿

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr'); for (const row of rows) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('新增视觉')); if (btn) return { found: true, disabled: btn.disabled, text: btn.textContent.trim() }; } return { found: false }; })()

(() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row, tbody tr'); for (const row of rows) { const btn = Array.from(row.querySelectorAll('button, a')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('新增视觉') && !b.disabled); if (btn) { btn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 点击可用店铺的新增视觉按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); if (!modal) return { found: false }; const title = modal.querySelector('.ant-modal-title, h3')?.textContent.trim(); const nameInput = modal.querySelector('input'); const saveBtn = Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => b.textContent.includes('保存')); return { found: true, title, nameInput: !!nameInput, saveBtn: !!saveBtn }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const nameInput = modal?.querySelector('input'); if (nameInput) { const longName = 'A'.repeat(41); const setter = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(window.HTMLInputElement.prototype, 'value').set; setter.call(nameInput, longName); nameInput.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return { inputLength: 41, maxLength: nameInput.maxLength }; } return { found: false }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在无进行中迭代的店铺，用户有创建权限
_testDesign.stepsText:
1. 找到无进行中迭代的店铺行
2. 点击新增视觉按钮
3. 验证弹窗展示迭代名称输入框
4. 输入超过40字验证限制
5. 空表单保存验证必填
_testDesign.expectedResult:
1. 有进行中迭代的店铺按钮置灰
2. 弹窗展示迭代名称输入框（必填，最多40字）
3. 不预填默认名称
4. 保存后创建迭代并进入详情页Brief tab
_testDesign.groupPath: 风格店铺协作平台/店铺列表
